Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell.

description.value:
Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell.

location.value: Drops from Leyndell Knights using the shield on their model (bow wielding knights who switch to the shield for close combat will not drop it). Most of which can be found in and around Leyndell, Royal Capital . One can be found south of the Artist's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes , this is the earliest available version of that enemy. The droprate for the shield (or anything other the guaranteed Dragon Cult Prayerbook), however, seems to be lower than on the capital knights.

Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell.

description.value:

location.value: Drops from Leyndell Knights using the shield on their model (bow wielding knights who switch to the shield for close combat will not drop it). Most of which can be found in and around Leyndell, Royal Capital . One can be found south of the Artist's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes , this is the earliest available version of that enemy. The droprate for the shield (or anything other the guaranteed Dragon Cult Prayerbook), however, seems to be lower than on the capital knights.
